EDDM in Phoenicia, NY

EDDM services for businesses and organizations in Phoenicia, Ulster County. In-house from our New Paltz facility since 1998.

EDDM Services for Phoenicia

Every Door Direct Mail (EDDM) lets you reach every address on a postal carrier route in Phoenicia without purchasing a mailing list. With a population of 1,200 and approximately 480 households across ZIP code 12464, Phoenicia offers a tight-knit market for EDDM saturation campaigns. Cornerstone Services handles route selection, mail piece design, commercial printing, and all USPS paperwork from our facility in New Paltz — approximately 45 minutes from Phoenicia. Phoenicia is a popular Catskill Mountain destination known for tubing on Esopus Creek, the Catskill Mountain Railroad, and a vibrant village center. Tourism-dependent businesses here rely on direct mail to maintain year-round awareness and drive seasonal traffic..

Phoenicia is home to organizations like Phoenicia Festival of the Voice, Catskill Mountain Railroad, Empire State Railway Museum — the types of businesses and institutions that rely on professional EDDM services.

Phoenicia's compact community of 1,200 residents and approximately 480 households is ideally suited for EDDM. What's Included

Route Selection via EDDM Online Tool

We use the USPS EDDM Online Tool to select carrier routes in and around your target area. The tool pulls U.S. Census demographics — household income, age, size — so we can target the routes most likely to respond. Cornerstone manages the entire route selection process through our Business Customer Gateway account.

Mail Piece Design & EDDM Retail Indicia

USPS-compliant oversized postcards and flat-size mailers designed for maximum impact. Every piece includes the required EDDM Retail Indicia — the postal marking that replaces a standard stamp or meter mark on EDDM mail. Standard sizes: 6.5"×9", 8.5"×11", 6"×11".

Commercial Printing

High-quality offset and digital printing on heavy card stock. Full color, both sides. Cornerstone is listed in the USPS Printer Directory as a qualified mail piece printer meeting USPS automation and design standards.

PS Form 3587 & Postal Delivery

We complete PS Form 3587 (the EDDM postage statement) for each mailing, prepare facing slips, bundle by route, and deliver to the destination post office or Business Mail Entry Unit (BMEU). Postage: $0.247/piece (Retail) or $0.214/piece (BMEU entry).

How the EDDM Process Works in Phoenicia

The EDDM process for Phoenicia starts with route selection using the USPS EDDM Online Tool, accessed through the USPS Business Customer Gateway. For Phoenicia's 480 households spread across an estimated 2 carrier routes in ZIP code 12464, the tool lets us filter by U.S. Census demographics — household income, age distribution, and household size — so your mail reaches the Phoenicia neighborhoods most relevant to your business.

For a full-saturation campaign covering all Phoenicia carrier routes, you're looking at approximately 480 pieces at $0.247/piece (Retail) or $0.214/piece (BMEU entry through the New Paltz facility). That puts the total postage cost between $103 and $119 — before printing and design. A complete all-in EDDM campaign for Phoenicia typically runs $163–$202 including design, printing on heavy card stock, and postage. Most Phoenicia businesses start with a partial-saturation campaign targeting 2–2 routes closest to their location.

Once routes are selected, we design your mail piece to meet USPS Marketing Mail standards. Every EDDM piece must include the EDDM Retail Indicia — a printed marking in the upper-right corner that replaces traditional postage. For Phoenicia businesses, we typically recommend the 6.5"×9" oversized postcard — it's large enough to stand out in the mailbox but keeps per-piece printing costs manageable for rural market campaigns.

Before delivery, we complete PS Form 3587 — the official USPS postage statement for EDDM mailings. This form documents the number of pieces, carrier routes, and postage due. For Phoenicia campaigns, we deliver to the New Paltz Business Mail Entry Unit (BMEU) to take advantage of the lower $0.214/piece BMEU rate vs. the $0.247/piece retail rate — saving $16 on a full-town mailing.

EDDM for Phoenicia Industries

Restaurants and food service businesses in Phoenicia use EDDM to promote grand openings, seasonal menus, catering services, and weekly specials. An oversized postcard with appetizing food photography mailed to every household within a 2–3 mile radius of the restaurant generates immediate traffic. For Phoenicia restaurants, we recommend starting with the 2 carrier routes closest to the business location, then expanding to the full 2 routes once response rates confirm the campaign is working.

Retail shops and boutiques in Phoenicia use EDDM to drive foot traffic for sales events, new product arrivals, and holiday promotions. The key advantage of EDDM for retail is saturation — every household on the route receives your postcard, including residents who might not follow your social media or visit your website. For Phoenicia retailers, a pre-holiday mailing 2–3 weeks before major shopping periods consistently generates strong ROI.

Tourism businesses, hotels, B&Bs, and vacation rentals in Phoenicia use EDDM in two ways: local mailings to build community relationships and awareness (important for word-of-mouth referrals), and targeted mailings to visitor-source markets promoting seasonal packages. For the local component, EDDM lets Phoenicia hospitality businesses reach every household affordably — building the kind of local goodwill that generates referral traffic.

EDDM FAQ for Phoenicia

How many households can EDDM reach in Phoenicia?
Phoenicia (ZIP 12464) has approximately 480 households spread across an estimated 2 carrier routes. A full-saturation EDDM campaign reaching every household costs approximately $163–$202 all-in, including design, printing, and postage. You can also select individual routes to target specific Phoenicia neighborhoods at a lower cost.
What does an EDDM campaign cost in Phoenicia?
For Phoenicia's approximately 480 households, a full-saturation campaign runs $163–$202 including design, printing on heavy card stock, and USPS postage at $0.214–$0.247 per piece. Postage alone ranges from $103 to $119. Partial-route campaigns targeting specific Phoenicia neighborhoods cost proportionally less.
How far is Cornerstone from Phoenicia?
Our New Paltz facility is approximately 25 miles (about 45 minutes) from Phoenicia. We handle all EDDM design, printing, and postal delivery from our facility and deliver finished mail to the New Paltz BMEU for entry into the USPS system. Most Phoenicia clients work with us by phone and email — no in-person visits required.
What is the EDDM Online Tool and do I need to use it myself?
The EDDM Online Tool is a USPS web application accessed through the Business Customer Gateway that lets mailers select carrier routes by ZIP code and demographic filters. For Phoenicia campaigns, Cornerstone handles the entire route selection process — you do not need a Business Customer Gateway account or access to the EDDM Online Tool. We select the routes, prepare PS Form 3587, and deliver to the New Paltz BMEU.
What is PS Form 3587?
PS Form 3587 is the USPS postage statement required for every EDDM mailing. It documents the number of mail pieces, selected carrier routes, and total postage due. For Phoenicia mailings, Cornerstone completes and submits PS Form 3587 as part of our service — you do not need to fill it out yourself.
What is the difference between EDDM Retail and BMEU entry?
EDDM Retail ($0.247/piece) allows drop-off at any post office, including the Phoenicia post office. BMEU entry ($0.214/piece) requires delivery to the New Paltz Business Mail Entry Unit. For a full Phoenicia saturation mailing of 480 pieces, BMEU entry saves approximately $16 in postage. Cornerstone handles BMEU entry for all campaigns to maximize your savings.
What EDDM mail piece sizes work best for Phoenicia businesses?
The most popular EDDM formats for Phoenicia businesses are the 6.5"×9" oversized postcard (cost-effective for rural market saturation), the 8.5"×11" flat (maximum visual impact for menus, event promotions, and real estate), and the 6"×11" postcard (a balance of size and cost). All formats include the required EDDM Retail Indicia and are printed full-color on both sides on heavy card stock.
